newsitem.title: CHINA: China, Australia in $16 mln wool joint venture.
newsitem.headline: China, Australia in $16 mln wool joint venture.

text.p: Australia's Blue Light Trading Co has signed an agreement with Dalian Duca Wool Top Co of China to set up a wool production joint venture in China's northeastern Liaoning province, the Xinhua news agency said.

The $16 million venture was expected to produce 2,000 tonnes of wool yarn in the first year of operation and would sell 70 percent of its output on the world market, the official agency said in a report late on Saturday.
Investment would be split equally between the Chinese and Australian partners, it said but gave no further details of the new venture.
